_comment: Client-specified destination order. Cultural clothing changes are allowed; preserve face and hairstyle. Regional attire is inspiration, not one uniform per destination.

destinations.label: Canarias
destinations.costumePrompt: Use the supplied CANARIAS clothing panel: white puff-sleeve blouse, black bodice with colourful embroidered edging and red lacing, white lace apron over a long narrow-striped multicolour skirt; OR white collared shirt, black waistcoat with red/green embroidery, red woven sash, black knee breeches and cream gaiters. Optional straw or black felt hat only if the visitor requests it and it does not obscure source hair or face. These are clothing design cues from the client’s reference, rendered as photorealistic garments with real fabric texture. Choose an appropriate dress or trouser option and honor an explicit visitor preference; never copy the reference people, change the guest’s face/body/hair or sexualize the outfit. No baseball or sports uniforms.
destinations.scenePrompt: Canary Islands photographic travel postcard scene: Tenerife’s distinctive Mount Teide volcanic summit and lava landscape, Atlantic blue water and subtropical island light. Use Tenerife as the specific scenic inspiration for Canarias; do not invent a coastline combining distant islands. No Santiago cathedral or mainland Spanish landmarks.
